001package org.clafer.choco.constraint.propagator;
002
003import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.Propagator;
004import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.PropagatorPriority;
005import org.chocosolver.solver.exception.ContradictionException;
006import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.IntVar;
007import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.SetVar;
008import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.Variable;
009import org.chocosolver.util.ESat;
010import org.chocosolver.util.objects.setDataStructures.ISetIterator;
011
012/**
013 *
014 * @author jimmy
015 */
016public class PropIntMemberSetCard extends Propagator<Variable> {
017
018    private final IntVar element;
019    private final SetVar set;
020    private final IntVar setCard;
021
022    public PropIntMemberSetCard(IntVar element, SetVar set, IntVar setCard) {
023        super(new Variable[]{set, element, setCard}, PropagatorPriority.BINARY, false);
024        this.element = element;
025        this.set = set;
026        this.setCard = setCard;
027    }
028
029    @Override
030    public void propagate(int evtmask) throws ContradictionException {
031        if (!PropUtil.isDomIntersectKer(element, set)) {
032            setCard.updateLowerBound(set.getLB().size() + 1, this);
033            if (setCard.getUB() == set.getLB().size() + 1) {
034                // set can take only one more value, and currently does not intersect element.
035                ISetIterator iter = set.getUB().iterator();
036                while (iter.hasNext()) {
037                    int i = iter.nextInt();
038                    if (!set.getLB().contains(i) && !element.contains(i)) {
039                        set.remove(i, this);
040                    }
041                }
042            }
043        } else {
044            setCard.updateLowerBound(1, this);
045        }
046    }
047
048    @Override
049    public ESat isEntailed() {
050        return ESat.TRUE;
051    }
052}
